column3: Genetic data from nuclear genes indicates that the monotypic group Golden Whistler (fuliginosa) Pachycephala pectoralis fuliginosa instead is a subspecies of Western Whistler Pachycephala occidentalis (Joseph et al. 2020a). As the name fuliginosa predates occidentalis, change the scientific name of Western Whistler from Pachycephala occidentalis to Pachycephala fuliginosa. With the transfer of subspecies fuliginosa from Golden Whistler Pachycephala pectoralis to Western Whistler Pachycephala fuliginosa, Western Whistler no longer is monotypic; the sequence of the two subspecies is occidentalis followed by nominate fuliginosa. Subspecies occidentalis and nominate fuliginosa are extremely similar, and are not field identifiable; therefore fuliginosa is listed simply as a subspecies, rather than as a monotypic eBird group.
